postProcessing.despill: edge-only magenta correction within three alpha-edge pixels
postProcessing.source: Body sources use border-connected magenta flood fill and three-pixel edge-band despill. The aura uses white-lift and and never chroma-keyed. Frames are placed on fixed 512x512 canvases with an 8px bottom margin. No dither, warping, per-frame registration, or metric-driven resizing is applied.
postProcessing.atlas: 3 columns by 2 rows, custom PixiJS v8 JSON

aura.prompt: Aura alone on pure white: soft watercolour purple and violet scribble swirls forming a loose ring, teal swirl dashes, six to eight lavender four-point sparkles, no frog, no black outlines, generous margin.
aura.engine: The engine rotates and pulses this single painted aura rather than shipping a translated duplicate.
aura.reason: Purple aura marks are too close to magenta for safe chroma keying, and translucent glow has no reliable single key colour.
aura.jpegFloor: Raw Gemini JPEG white-background deviations below 8/255 are treated as paper; no colour correction or alpha cleanup beyond the documented paper floor is applied.
